definition: Adolescence is the developmental period leading from the onset of puberty toward maturity, usually understood as the stage between puberty and adult maturity. In this historical psychology source, it is described as a time of marked bodily change and heightened, changeable emotional and mental life, often with stronger ideals, passions, friendships, and independence-seeking.
